skills.name: using-pulse
skills.description: Use at the start of any project task, including small changes, prototypes and unclear ideas, or when resuming an existing Pulse run.

dependencies.reason: Pulse ICM run and graph helpers require Node.js 18+.

skills.name: exploring
skills.description: Use when a new Pulse run needs product and architecture decisions locked before planning.

skills.name: planning
skills.description: Use after Pulse exploration when approved decisions need one plan and a work graph.

skills.name: validating
skills.description: Use after Pulse planning to verify the plan and work graph before execution approval.

dependencies.reason: Pulse graph validation and connectivity analysis require Node.js 18+.

skills.name: executing
skills.description: Use when an approved Pulse work graph is ready for single-worker or swarm execution.

skills.name: reviewing
skills.description: Use after Pulse execution to produce final findings and UAT evidence before merge approval.

skills.name: compounding
skills.description: Use after approved Pulse review to capture durable post-cycle learnings.
